paper_id: Wang et al. - 2015 - BlindDate A Neighbor Discovery Protocol
title: BlindDate: A Neighbor Discovery Protocol
venue: IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems
motivation: 移动社交和城市传感应用需要高效的邻居发现协议，但设备能量受限且时钟异步，导致现有协议效率低下
problem_framing: 将邻居发现问题形式化为异步设备间活动时隙的重叠问题，要求在相同时/不同duty cycle下最小化发现延迟
key_insight: 通过在同一设备的多个Dynamic块中使用相反移动方向的bouncing slots，使不同设备的Dynamic slots在重叠区相遇的概率最大化
method_signature: 将周期t分为m块、每块s时隙，设Static slot固定+Dynamic slot bouncing移动，k=2,m=5为最优奇数配置
evaluation_criteria: worst-case discovery latency bound和average-case latency，在相同时duty cycle下与Disco/U-Connect/Searchlight比较
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 当m为奇数且p=1时无法找到可行解；asymmetric case只给出宽松上界，实际性能可能更好
evidence_for_taste: Unluckily, we cannot find a feasible solution
the worst-case discovery latency of BD protocol is around 10 percent smaller
BD protocol achieves 30 40 percent performance gain in average
we cannot neglect the fact that this increases the energy consumption
thinking_moves: case-by-case分析k与m的关系以保证发现成功
从Searchlight的单probe slot扩展到多 Dynamic slots with opposite directions
通过bouncing step=2使hyper-period减半，从而延迟减半
针对alignment case的slot jump问题，用延长beacon时间+平移到相邻slot解决
extraction_notes: paper content完整但conference version [24]未提供；role根据署名顺序和senior author位置判断
